name: experimentation-platform-backend
description: Experimentation platform: flags and experiments with versioned configs and an audit log, deterministic bucketing with stable ranges, immutable per-environment ruleset snapshots served with ETags and pushed over SSE through Valkey pub/sub, a kill switch, render-time exposure ingest into ClickHouse with batch and event dedup, and exposed-only analysis with Wilson intervals, lift and a sample ratio mismatch check

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api-a,api-b,ingest -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:a" "npm run dev:b" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api-a,api-b,ingest "INSTANCE_ID=api-a PORT=${PORT_A:-3000} tsx src/api/index.ts" "INSTANCE_ID=api-b PORT=${PORT_B:-3001} tsx src/api/index.ts" "tsx src/ingest/index.ts"
